12 Jyotirlinga: Brahma-Vishnu Ki Test Mein Shiv Jeete! 🌟

🔱 Jyotirlinga origin Brahma Vishnu argument infinite column of light

When Brahma and Vishnu argued about who was supreme, Shiva appeared as an infinite pillar of light. Both tried to find the ends — Brahma flew up, Vishnu dug down — neither could. Shiva revealed himself as formless infinity. The 12 places where he appeared as light became the 12 Jyotirlingas.
